title: Chicken Broth
description: Chicken Broth is a classic Continental stock prepared by slowly simmering chicken with aromatic vegetables and herbs to create a clear, flavorful broth. It can be served on its own or used as the foundation for soups and sauces.

ingredients.title: For the Broth Base
items: Whole chicken (free-range, about 1.2–1.5 kg) OR chicken bones + wings – 1.5 kg
Carrot – 2 medium, peeled and roughly chopped
Onion – 1 large, halved (charred for deeper flavor, optional)

ingredients.title: For Finishing
items: Fresh herbs: chervil, parsley, or thyme
Fine brunoise of carrots or leeks (for garnish)

instruction.title: Step 1 – Prepare the Chicken
steps: Rinse the chicken or bones under cold water.
If using bones, blanch them in boiling water for 5 minutes, then rinse to remove impurities.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Build the Broth
steps: Place the chicken or bones in a large stockpot and cover with cold water.
Bring slowly to a gentle simmer.
Skim off any foam and impurities that rise to the surface.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Add the Aromatics
steps: Add carrots, onion, leek, celery, garlic, bay leaves, thyme, parsley stems, and peppercorns.
Maintain a gentle simmer and avoid boiling to keep the broth clear.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Slow Simmer
steps: Do not stir the broth during cooking.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Strain and Finish
steps: Remove the chicken or bones from the pot.
Strain the broth through a fine chinois or cheesecloth.
For a clearer broth, chill, remove the fat, and clarify with egg whites if desired.
Adjust seasoning with salt before serving.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve hot in a porcelain soup cup or clear bowl.
Garnish with fine vegetable brunoise and fresh herbs.
Pair with freshly baked baguette crisps or a Parmesan tuile.
Use as a base for soups, sauces, and risottos.

chefTips: Always start with cold water to extract maximum flavor.
Maintain a gentle simmer to produce a crystal-clear broth.
Skim impurities regularly for a cleaner taste and appearance.
Strain through muslin for a refined restaurant-quality finish.
For consommé-style broth, clarify with egg whites before serving.
